meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build composition projects with HyperFrames and need specification guidance

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据 HTML 文件生成可渲染的视频。它会使用 data-* 属性控制时间，管理媒体播放，并确保视频可拖动进度条。
howto.when: 当你要求制作一个 HyperFrames 视频项目，或需要编写/修改组合 HTML 文件时触发。

say.text: 创建一个最小可渲染的 HyperFrames 组合。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个基础 HTML 骨架。

say.text: 给这个组合添加一个视频轨道，时长5秒。
检查这个组合的验证结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate a renderable video from an HTML file. It uses data-* attributes for timing, manages media playback, and ensures the timeline is seekable.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a HyperFrames video project, or need to write/modify composition HTML files.

say_en.text: Create a minimal renderable HyperFrames composition.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a basic HTML skeleton.

say_en.text: Add a video track to this composition with 5-second duration.
say_en.note: Claude will add data-track-index and data-duration.
Claude will execute npx hyperframes check.
